content: To bridge the space gap, our idea is to pull $\mathbf {h^s}$ into the latent space where $\mathbf {e}^s$ belong. Specifically, we share the weight $W_{ctc}$ in CTC classification layer with the source embedding weights $W_{E^s}$, which means $W_{ctc} = W_{E^s}$. In this way, when predicting the CTC path $\mathbf {\pi }$, the probability of observing the particular label $w_i \in V_{src}\cup ${`-'} at time step $t$, $p(\pi _t=w_i|\mathbf {x})$, is computed by normalizing the product of hidden vector $h_t^s$ and the $i$-th vector in $W_{E^s}$:
